repo_prior_art.cite: none; the Panel catalogue contains no survival/censoring spectral-SSC inference result

published_prior_art.cite: HanShah2025SSC supplies SSC consistency, WestlingLuedtkeGilbertCarone2024 supplies one-law orthogonal survival inference, and GolubPereyra1973 supplies the derivative; none supplies their three-block composition.
WestlingLuedtkeGilbertCarone2024 supplies feasible survival bands and integrated-contrast inference; the added content is propagation through the new transported influence vector.

CurthPoonNoriGonzalez2024 studies survival-SC bias and WestlingLuedtkeGilbertCarone2024 distinguishes covariate-adjusted survival targets, but neither gives this three-block KM/PCR probability-limit calculation or an open nonzero-bias subclass.
ChoiKwonLiao2026RankRobust treats high-dimensional linear functionals with diversified projections, not fixed-panel nonlinear pseudoinverse transport under survival-score noise.

novelty_flags.label: Open-ended Question 1
novelty_flags.one_line: The weak-gap handle invokes diversified projection but omits the directly relevant FanLiao2022 JASA weak/over-estimated-factor result; add it and distinguish its high-dimensional factor regime from the proposed fixed-panel collision experiment.

soundness_flags.label: Proposition 1
soundness_flags.one_line: “Consistent for θ iff β_KM=0” merely unfolds β_KM as the naive probability limit minus θ; replace it with an independent primitive characterization of cancellation, or retain only the substantive probability-limit, open-set, and witness claims.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorems 1–2
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Exact donor-span and post-period donor transport are maintained identifying premises rather than results derived by this project.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The joint limit law, band, and grid-RMST interval hold conditional on the exact SSC transport model and fixed positive singular gap; this is an inference contribution, not a claimed derivation of transport.

source_verification_receipts.locator: §3.4.3 and Appendix E.1–E.2, especially lines 708–714 of the rendered source
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: SSC uses Kaplan–Meier cell estimates, a well-conditioned spectral regime, row-space transport, and a finite-sample consistency proof.

source_verification_receipts.version: JASA 119(546), publisher issue record; full theorem text was inaccessible from the publisher
source_verification_receipts.locator: Issue contents: article pages 1541–1553; publisher abstract/metadata
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The cited JASA article exists and concerns a cross-fitted doubly robust estimator with pointwise and uniform asymptotic linearity for treatment-specific survival curves; theorem-number details require primary-text verification before any mismatch flag.
The paper studies PCR in a high-dimensional fixed-design error-in-variables setting and derives minimum-norm identification and non-asymptotic out-of-sample prediction guarantees.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Publisher abstract and bibliographic record, pp. 413–432
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The cited article develops Fréchet derivatives of the Moore–Penrose inverse under locally constant rank; the cited equation (4.12) is the standard constant-rank formula.
The paper analyzes interpolation/distributional bias of survival synthetic controls and discusses censoring, but not the proposed panel-cell KM/PCR pseudo-limit or cancellation frontier.
The article establishes rank-misspecification-robust inference for linear functionals of high-dimensional low-rank matrices using diversified projections.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Remove the definitional cancellation iff and state a noncancellation criterion directly in primitive conditional event/censor hazards or pseudo-limit perturbation coordinates; preserve the explicit rational witness and relative-openness result as corollaries.
Add Fan and Liao (2022) to the weak-gap survey, then specify which singular-collision path, rank rule, and stabilization rule are to be separated from diversified-projection factor inference.

Promote the weak-gap question into a concrete phase-boundary target: derive an explicit rate condition on Δ_K, give a named stabilized estimator, and pair attainability with a contiguous two-path impossibility result.

recommended_next_step: Continue revision on this angle: repair the vacuous cancellation iff and deepen the weak-gap literature/comparator boundary before advancing the field-tier inference kernel to Stage 0.
